SeqFeatures: N-terminal amino acid sequence  This sequence matches sequences of four homologous species of Trichophyton, by BLASTP
IsoAllergenicity: The taxonomy of Arthroderma and Trichophyton is a bit messy. [Arthroderma benhamiae (anamorph: Trichophyton mentagrophytes]. Tri m 4, Tri r 4 and Tri t 4 appear to be homologues that are close. These proteins seem to be important in IgE mediated and DTH responses in those with skin or nail fungal infections who are also IgE sensitized and experience immediate responses. Woodfolk has a very good review in 2005, and also specific IgE binding in 1998.      The Woodfolk 1996 article used sera from 30 subjects with SPT + tests to Hollister-Stier's Trichophyton mixture (T. tonsurans, T. rubrum and T. mentagrophytes. They also used individuals with althletes foot. The protein was purified from T. tonsurans, characterized with N-terminal sequencing. It was used as a target for IgE in ELISA and RAST. Six of nine individuals with immediate hypersensitivity had SPT positive responses to Tri t 4 (= Tri m 4).    See also Trichophyton 2, as well as Trichophyton 4 (a different protein, but probably involved in the same reactions.
